adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::GroupsController#remove_member`, the diff adds `group.users.delete(user_id)` (new code). Using `delete` on an association removes the join row without instantiating/destroying the join model, so any `destroy` callbacks on the has-many-through join (e.g., `GroupUser`) would be skipped. The finding’s claim that this *definitely* raises `RecordNotFound` for non-members isn’t directly verifiable from the diff (depends on Rails association behavior and whether the id is in-scope), but the callback-bypass concern is real and diff-grounded and could be behaviorally important.
